parameters.name: t
parameters.description: Image reference to tag the result with (repeatable). Default `nyx-build:<id>`.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Build up to this stage (`FROM ... AS <name>`).

parameters.name: X-Registry-Config
parameters.description:
Credentials for pulling `FROM` images: base64url-encoded JSON mapping registry host
(`docker.io`, `ghcr.io`, `localhost:5000`) to `{"username": ..., "password": ...}`.
Used for this build only. `nyx build` fills it from your docker, podman or nyx login.
